findings.issue: "浏览器面板" renders "browser pane" with 面板 (panel). The same section calls the panel rail 面板栏, and the only other user-facing translation of this surface (ui.browser "This pane is too narrow …") uses 窗格. Calling the browser a 面板 in a section about 面板栏 blurs the exact distinction this copy exists to draw.
findings.remediation: Changed 浏览器面板 -> 浏览器窗格 (one occurrence) to match the corpus term for a pane and avoid the panel-rail collision.
